facts.value: Runs grounded collision processing for LiftWait, supplying ftCo_80096E68 as the ground-loss callback. On ground loss, that callback drops a present held item with zero supplied velocity and scalar, then dispatches through ftCo_80090780's DamageFall handling, including its parasol-specific alternative. If no item remains, it calls ftCo_Fall_Enter directly.

facts.value: Forwards the Fighter_GObj unchanged to ft_80085088, which reads ground_friction and facing_dir and passes them to ft_800850E0. When Fighter.x594_b0 is set, that helper assigns gr_vel from x6A4_transNOffset.z multiplied by facing direction; otherwise it applies ground friction. Both paths then call ftCommon_ApplyGroundMovement. The LiftWalk wrapper itself has no local field accesses or transition logic.
